{"sourceType":"ESA Tender Action","sourceSystem":"ESA esa-star Publication","sourcePage":"https://esastar-publication-ext.sso.esa.int/ESATenderActions/filter/open","id":6705,"idEra":9621,"activityNumber":"1000025248","contractNumber":"","tanumber":"1-9776","title":"EXPRO+ NAVISP ELEMENT 1 (NAVISP-EL1-011): RESILIENT, TRUSTWORTHY, UBIQUITOUS TIME TRANSFER REISSUE","description":"This REISSUED EXPRO+ procurement is part of the NAVISP Programme, under Elelment 1, Work Plan 2018.An accurate, secure and reliable time transfer is a key enabler for emerging fixed and mobile services worldwide.
